benefits.desc: Peganum harmala reduces inflammation markers because it contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. benefits.definition: Inflammatory markers are abnormal levels of proteins or chemicals in the body that signal chronic inflammation. Chronic inflammation is a persistent, low-level immune response that can damage tissues over time. It is often caused by prolonged exposure to irritants, infections, or genetic factors, and is commonly experienced by individuals with autoimmune disorders, metabolic syndrome, or chronic diseases like arthritis and diabetes. Peganum harmala plant has shown potential in reducing these markers through its bioactive compounds, which may modulate inflammatory pathways. This effect could offer therapeutic benefits for those suffering from persistent inflammatory conditions.
benefits.constituents: Peganum harmala reduces inflammation markers because it contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids and flavonoids.
